ctx.x: Nazarro, not they -- Nazarro would introduce. He was the head man of the act. Nat Nazarro was the head man of the act. So he would be the one, the kid that worked with him didn't say nothing, didn't do nothing. He and the kid might talk something together but the kid ain't going to
